page_title: SAL 0-3 TOR | Salernitana v Torino 18/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
90+2' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
90+1' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
87' Today's match ends for Samuele Ricci who will be replaced by Gvidas Gineitis (Torino).
87' Ivan Juric decides to make a substitution. Duvan Zapata will be replaced by Pietro Pellegri (Torino).

86' The corner is swung into the six-yard box and Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) gets his head on the ball, but he is unable to keep it down and it goes miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
85' The ball is out of play. Salernitana win a corner kick.

83' Federico Fazio (Salernitana) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the roof of the net, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
81' The foul by Federico Fazio (Salernitana) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Antonio Giua.
80' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
79' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
78' Ivan Juric prepares a substitution. Nemanja Radonjic is replaced by Yann Karamoh (Torino).
78' Substitution. Demba Seck will be replaced by Karol Linetty (Torino).

77' Duvan Zapata sprays a pass out to Nemanja Radonjic (Torino), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.

77' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
74' A yellow card for a tackle by Perr Schuurs (Torino). Antonio Giua doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
73' Antonio Giua blows his whistle as Adrien Tameze (Torino) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
71' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!

70' Demba Seck (Torino) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
70' Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) commits a rough challenge and Antonio Giua blows his whistle for a foul.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Brandon Soppy (Torino) comes onto the pitch for Raoul Bellanova.
68' Paulo Sousa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Federico Fazio (Salernitana) replacing Domagoj Bradaric.
68' Substitution. Mateusz Legowski walks off the pitch and Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) comes on as a substitute.
65' Samuele Ricci (Torino) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

64' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
62' Perr Schuurs (Torino) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

61' A precise low pass is received by Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
60' The goal by Torino won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
59' The Torino players halt their celebrations as referee Antonio Giua makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

58' 0:4. Nemanja Radonjic (Torino) latches on to a pass on the edge of the penalty area and immediately fires a fantastic first-time shot into the bottom right corner. What a finish that is! Guillermo Ochoa did his best to stop it, but the shot was just too good. Duvan Zapata provided the assistance.
57' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) sends a cross into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off his line to gather the ball.
57' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the corner which is cleared.
56' A cross from Nemanja Radonjic (Torino) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Torino.

54' Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.

52' Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.

50' 0 - 3 Goal! Raoul Bellanova produces a great pass that finds Nemanja Radonjic (Torino) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a low shot into the back of the net. 0:3.
49' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

47' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
46' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Antonio Giua ignores the protests.
46' The game is over for Emil Bohinen (Salernitana). Agustin Martegani comes on for the second half.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Paulo Sousa gives a chance to Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi and Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) is off.
46' Paulo Sousa has made a change at the break. Loum Tchaouna has come on in place of Erik Botheim (Salernitana).
46' Referee Antonio Giua blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' What a chance that is! Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the right post!
45+3' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Guillermo Ochoa, who smothers the ball.
45+2' Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Antonio Giua shows a yellow card to Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) for a tough tackle.

41' 0 - 2 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Nemanja Radonjic (Torino) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the right side of the net.
40' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
37' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
35' Emil Bohinen (Salernitana) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
35' Antonio Giua blows his whistle after Raoul Bellanova (Torino) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.

33' That's unlucky! Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) picks up the ball within his own half and goes on a mazy run before shooting from distance. The ball looks in all the way but curls at the last second and flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
31' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic intercepts the ball.
30' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
29' Samuele Ricci (Torino) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
26' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
24' Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) commits a foul and Antonio Giua immediately signals a free kick.
24' Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
22' The Torino players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
20' Flag goes up against Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
17' Adrien Tameze (Torino) is penalised for a foul. Antonio Giua had a clear view and blows his whistle.
15' 0 - 1 Goal! Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
15' Now Torino have a corner.
14' Nemanja Radonjic (Torino) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
11' The game is interrupted as Nemanja Radonjic (Torino) is flagged offside.

10' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the right side of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic made an astonishing save!
8' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
6' Erik Botheim (Salernitana) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
4' Perr Schuurs (Torino) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
3' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

1' Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Torino will have the kick-off.
Antonio Giua got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
